_note: Playing as a team, on one screen. Each player owns part of the spacecraft, and when a challenge happens to that part it is their call. The order below is the order roles are handed out, so two players get a Flight Director and a Power Engineer; anything nobody owns falls to the Flight Director, who has the final word.

roles.name: Flight Director
roles.blurb: Owns the bus and the engine, and takes any call nobody else owns.

roles.name: Power Engineer
roles.blurb: Owns the solar panels or the nuclear battery. No power, no mission.

roles.name: Comms Officer
roles.blurb: Owns the antenna. Science nobody can hear is science nobody has.

roles.name: Science Lead
roles.blurb: Owns the instruments, and everything the mission is actually for.

_ownsNote: The engine is not listed against anyone: like anything unclaimed it goes to the Flight Director. Give it its own role here and a fifth player would own it.
